title: The 2026 Florida Statutes, Title XXXI, Chapter 448 — Terms and Conditions of Employment
verified_how: fetched the register chapter page: 'The 2026 Florida Statutes', heading 'CHAPTER 448 TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT (ss. 448.01-448.111)', with the section list from 448.01 onwards.
notes: Contains the Florida Minimum Wage Act (§ 448.110), which implements the minimum wage set by Fla. Const. art. X, § 24. Florida has no general wage-payment-and-collection statute for private employers, and § 448.077 preempts local scheduling regulation.
